changelog:
1.3.0 — 31 October 2026

  • New: AI Assistant preview: ask questions about your store in plain words (coming soon).
  • New: Pro now includes every feature, with extra sites available as an add-on.
  • Improved: Clearer plan names across the dashboard.

1.2.1 — 30 October 2026

  • Improved: Cleaner dashboard that uses the WordPress menu.
  • Improved: Plugin name and branding shown the same everywhere.

1.2.0 — 29 October 2026

  • New: Redesigned dashboard: bigger numbers, a live card and cleaner reports.
  • Improved: Settings arranged in three columns you can drag and drop.
  • Fixed: Buttons in the mobile app settings no longer overlap.

1.1.0 — 27 October 2026

  • New: Email marketing: templates, contact lists, safe sending and orders per campaign.
  • New: Areas inside cities, with Top areas and Traffic by Area.
  • New: New plugin features now appear in the mobile app automatically.

1.0.9 — 24 October 2026

  • New: Mobile app for iPhone and Android: connect with a QR code.
  • New: Notifications for visitors, orders, carts, stock and checkout problems.
  • New: Choose the time of your email report.
  • Improved: Real-time: last 30 minutes next to recent visitors.

1.0.8 — 21 October 2026

  • New: City and region for every visit, and Sales by City for ad targeting.
  • New: Month-start reminder for carts left last month.

1.0.7 — 18 October 2026

  • New: Abandoned cart recovery: three reminder emails with a coupon on the last one.
  • New: Payment links for pending and draft orders.
  • Improved: Store emails use your store name and colors.

1.0.6 — 15 October 2026

  • New: Session recordings stored on your own site, with a new player.
  • Improved: Recordings load after the page has finished loading.
  • Improved: More reliable automatic updates.

1.0.5 — 12 October 2026

  • New: Custom date ranges, email reports, alerts and white-label reports.
  • New: Store, customer, inventory, search, 404 and blog reports.
  • Fixed: Sales now include orders with custom statuses such as Shipped.

1.0.4 — 9 October 2026

  • New: Conversion funnel, button clicks, forms and new vs returning visitors.
  • Improved: Real-time pages update every second without refreshing.

1.0.3 — 6 October 2026

  • New: Store sales, orders, top products and sales by source.
  • Fixed: Visitors now appear right away on sites with caching plugins.

1.0.2 — 3 October 2026

  • New: Traffic sources: ads vs organic, email and AI tools like ChatGPT.
  • New: Pages, entry and exit pages, devices and time on site.
  • Fixed: Visitors blocked by ad blockers are counted again.

1.0.1 — 1 October 2026

  • New: Beta release: live visitors, world map and today’s visitors in your WordPress dashboard.
name: StorePinger
